title: Berkovich $2$-motives and normed ring stacks
summary: The de Rham stack construction of Simpson shows that D-modules are quasicoherent sheaves on a modified geometry. Drinfeld furthermore introduced the ring stack perspective (aka transmutation), which asserts that a coefficient theory is determined by a ring stack. Scholze proposed relating this idea to motivic realizations using $(\infty,2)$-categorical language.
